thread:
incident-bot: Pager: control-plane critical — elevated 5xx rates observed across auth and org-lookup paths. automatic-sla: P95 latency 2300ms, errors >12% since 00:03 UTC. paging oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: Acked. I'm on it, jumping into logs and metrics.

alex_dev: I'm seeing a spike of 502s from billing-service when org-lookup is queried; spike started ~00:01 UTC. tracing shows increased downstream latency to billing-db.

maria_prod: Customer impact: several Hosted API customers report generation timeouts and 5xx when calling Redwood API (chat/generate). Early repros show gateway returning 502 from control-plane auth fanout.

jamal_cp: Confirmed. Govies: org-lookup 5xx ripple -> auth proxy times out -> gateway returns 502. Metric snapshots: org-lookup error rate 24%, auth proxy errors 18%.

ops-bot: Recent deploy: controlplane-config v8.4.1 rolled at 23:58 UTC with new cache eviction TTL change. Rollout targeted canary then global.

oncall-sre: Good catch. I want to rule out the config change. Can someone grep deploy logs for v8.4.1 and the instance IDs?

alex_dev: grabbing deploys — found rollout to all prod controlplane nodes at 23:59:12. Patch touched org-lookup client retry/backoff config.

maria_prod: Correlating: error spike starts ~00:01 — fits the timeline. Priority: try rapid rollback to v8.4.0 on a canary subset to validate.

oncall-sre: Agreed. Jamal, can you patch a canary rollback? If rollback reduces error rate we confirm regression.

jamal_cp: Initiating canary rollback for controlplane (subset cp-us-east-1-*) now.

ops-bot: Action queued: rollback controlplane-config -> v8.4.0 on cp-us-east-1-canary (3 nodes).

oncall-sre: While that runs, throttle incoming traffic at the gateway for affected routes to reduce fanout. Apply temporary circuit-breaker on /v1/org-lookup to fail fast and fallback to cached orgs.

alex_dev: Pushing temporary policy:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/org-lookup",
  "circuit_breaker": {
    "max_concurrent": 8,
    "error_threshold": 0.1,
    "fail_fast": true
  },
  "fallback": "local-cache"
}
```

oncall-sre: Throttling policy applied. Monitoring ingress rates.

ops-bot: Canary rollback complete on cp-us-east-1-canary (3 nodes) at 00:07:34 UTC.

maria_prod: Early signal: org-lookup errors on canary down from 24% -> 6% within 30s. Looks promising.

jamal_cp: Rolling back global now — orchestrating staged rollback to v8.4.0 across remaining nodes with 30s stagger.

alex_dev: Note: billing-service DB connection pool shows spikes of exhausted connections. Config change adjusted retry/backoff which probably increased concurrency against billing DB. Could be combined effect.

oncall-sre: Good note. Run a quick query on billing DB pool stats and scale DB pool if possible. Also open a ticket for long-term fix.

ops-bot: Global rollback in progress. 50% done at 00:10 UTC.

oncall-sre: I'm paginating affected customers list. Priority customers: acct-233, acct-899, and acct-redwood-prod have repeated failures. Maria, can you notify CS/AM for those accounts asap?

maria_prod: On it — sending AMs and temporary status update: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting API requests that may result in timeouts; mitigation in progress."

jamal_cp: Rollback completed at 00:12:41 UTC.

oncall-sre: Observability: org-lookup error rate dropped to 4%, auth proxy errors to 3%, gateway 502s reduced to baseline. P95 latency back under 400ms.

alex_dev: Verified traffic rebalanced, cache fallback handled some spikes. Billing DB pool connections remain slightly elevated but within thresholds after small DB pool increase applied by DB-ops at 00:09.

maria_prod: Customer impact assessment: transient 5–15 minute degradations for a small percentage of requests. No data loss. We should prepare post-incident message.

oncall-sre: Triage notes so far: root cause likely config rollback of org-lookup/client retry/backoff that amplified downstream DB pressure (billing-db) -> org-lookup errors -> auth fanout timeouts -> gateway 502s. Remediation: rollback to v8.4.0 immediate fix, add circuit breaker + fallback, and increase DB pool as stopgap.

jamal_cp: Adding temporary monitoring alert to detect org-lookup > 5% 5xx and auth-proxy > 5% errors for 5m window.

ops-bot: Alert created: cp-orglookup-5xx-spike now set.

oncall-sre: Handoff: I'll stay with incident for 15 more minutes to ensure stability, then hand to oncall-sre-next (scheduled). @pagerduty I'll trigger escalation if error rates climb.

pagerduty: Acknowledged. next-oncall: @sre-next.

maria_prod: Preparing status blurb for status.redwood.ai and email to impacted customers: will include timeline, root cause, mitigation steps, and next steps.

alex_dev: Posting small repro and diff for the config change to the controlplane repo: `git show v8.4.1..v8.4.0 -- config/org_client_retry` — will include in incident writeup.

oncall-sre: Post-incident action items: 1) revert config change permanently until reviewed; 2) add load-safety limits to org-lookup client; 3) DB pooling improvements and autoscaling for billing-db; 4) add synthetic tests for org-lookup under high concurrency; 5) improve deploy rollback speed and canary thresholds.

maria_prod: I'll create an incident ticket and start coordinating the postmortem draft.

oncall-sre: Thanks team. Closing pager after 30m of stable metrics; will update when I handoff. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident cleared for paging if no further events.

oncall-sre: Metrics stable for 30m, handing off to sre-next. Final note: root cause config change to org-lookup backoff introduced pathological retry behavior -> DB pressure -> service 5xx cascade. Will include timeline and logs in the postmortem.

maria_prod: Finalizing customer comms and postmortem stub.

jamal_cp: Logged follow-up tickets: CP-4523 (config rollback), CP-4524 (circuit-breaker + fallback), DB-778 (pool autoscale).

oncall-sre: Handoff complete. Good job everyone. :tada:
